synthetic_instruments: Deterministic product and market index functions used only to identify the POC's synthetic logit reference; they are not economic instruments, calibration evidence, or runtime inputs.
identification_policy: FAIL_CLOSED: demand moments and instrument matrix rank must each cover the estimated parameter count; PyBLP warning diagnostics and non-convergence reject the case. This is synthetic numerical sufficiency, not instrument relevance, exogeneity, or calibration proof.
artifact_integrity_policy: artifact_digest proves canonical self-integrity only. Reviewed frozen-reference comparison supplies numerical equivalence evidence.
supply_chain_limit: requirements.lock is version-pinned without distribution hashes; the SBOM is an inventory and not a complete license or provenance attestation.
removal: Delete tools/pyblp-reference-poc and its ignored .venv; no migration or runtime rollback is required.
explicit_non_proofs: course, run, settlement, score, rank, or replay integration
real enterprise or personal data readiness
durable recovery, pilot, or production readiness
